target.query: from(bucket: "smokeping") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "host_uplink" and (r._field == "previous" or r._field == "interface" or r._field == "kind")) |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.previous) |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, text: "Uplink " + r.previous + " → " + (if r.interface == "" then "none" else r.interface + " (" + r.kind + ")"), tags: "uplink"}))

from(bucket: "smokeping") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns_resolver" and (r._field == "previous" or r._field == "owner")) |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "path"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.previous) |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, text: "Resolver via " + r.path + ": " + r.previous + " → " + r.owner, tags: "resolver"}))

list.name: target
list.label: Target
list.query: from(bucket: "smokeping") |> range(start: -24h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "latency" and r.category == "topsites") |> keep(columns: ["target"]) |> distinct(column: "target") |> sort(columns: ["target"])

panels.title: Top Sites Target – [[target]]
panels.description: Latency percentiles (p10/p20/p80/p90), mean, median and min/max envelope per target; red bars mark downtime windows.

targets.query: from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._measurement == "latency" and r.target == "[[target]]" and r._field == "median") |> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with _value: r._value * 1000.0 })) |> yield(name:"median")

from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._measurement == "latency" and r.target == "[[target]]" and r._field =~ /ping[0-9]+/) |> aggregateWindow(every:1m, fn: mean, createEmpty:false) |> group(columns:["target","_time"]) |> mean() |> set(key:"_field", value:"mean") |> group(columns:["target","_field"]) |> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with _value: r._value * 1000.0 })) |> yield(name:"mean")

import "math"
from(bucket:"smokeping")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._measurement == "latency" and r.target == "[[target]]" and r._field =~ /ping[0-9]+/ and not math.isNaN(f: r._value))  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: min, createEmpty:false) |> group(columns:["target", "_time"])
  |> min() |> group(columns:["target"])
  |> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with _value: r._value * 1000.0 }))
  |> rename(columns:{_value: "min"})
  |> keep(columns:["_time", "min"])
  |> yield(name:"min")

import "math"
from(bucket:"smokeping")  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._measurement == "latency" and r.target == "[[target]]" and r._field =~ /ping[0-9]+/ and not math.isNaN(f: r._value))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: max, createEmpty:false)
  |> group(columns:["target", "_time"])
  |> max()
  |> group(columns:["target"])
  |> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with _value: r._value * 1000.0 }))
  |> rename(columns:{_value: "max"})
  |> keep(columns:["_time", "max"])
  |> yield(name:"max")

from(bucket:"smokeping") |> range(start:v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._measurement == "latency" and r.target == "[[target]]" and (r._field == "loss" or r._field == "pings")) |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey:["_field"], valueColumn:"_value") |> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with _value: (if not exists r.loss then 0.0 else if r.loss > 1.0 then 1.0 else r.loss) * (if exists r.pings then float(v: r.pings) else if r._measurement == "latency" then 10.0 else 5.0) })) |> aggregateWindow(every:15m, fn: sum, createEmpty:false) |> map(fn:(r)=> ({ r with _value: if r._value >= 1.5 then 500.0 else 0.0 })) |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._value > 0) |> set(key:"_field", value:"unreachable") |> group(columns:["_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "_field", "target", "category", "probe_type"]) |> yield(name:"unreachable")
